motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to approve the Consent Agenda , with Item 10.A. removed and tabled. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Consent agenda approved, one item held back
motions.summary: The council approved the routine consent agenda, but set aside item 10.A. for a later decision.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Considering the Disposal of a Portion of Utah County Parcel #46:536:0430, designated as “Significant Real Property” Pursuant to EMMC 3.30.060 and 3.30.070 and directed the applicant to work with neighboring property owners, the City Attorney, and the Recorder’s Office to identify a better solution
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to table a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Considering the Disposal of a Portion of Utah County Parcel #46:536:0430, designated as “Significant Real Property” Pursuant to EMMC 3.30.060 and 3.30.070 and directed the applicant to work with neighboring property owners, the City Attorney, and the Recorder’s Office to identify a better solution . Councilmember Clark seconded the motion. Councilmember Wood withdrew the motion.
motions.headline: Move to delay city land decision withdrawn
motions.summary: A proposal to delay the decision on parcel #46:536:0430 and have the applicant seek a better solution with neighbors and city staff was withdrawn.

motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to table an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code section 17.72.040 Screening for Mu lti-Family Buildings , with direction to revise provisions related to heat pumps and screening standards , review spacing requirements to ensure proper airflow, incorporate the Planning Commission’s redline revisions, and return the item as a consent agenda item. Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Screening rules for apartment buildings delayed
motions.summary: The council delayed new rules on screening heat pumps and equipment at apartment buildings, asking for revisions to spacing and airflow standards before the rules return.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code 17.60 and 17.10 regarding Fencing
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code section 17.60 and 17.10 Regarding Fencing with the following amendments being made: 1. Require Corten ( weathering ) steel to be a minimum of 1/8 inch thick and add this requirement to Section 17.60.120; and 2. Prohibit corrugated material of any type under Section 17.60.120(1)(C); and 3. Remove the annual sealing requirement ; and 4. Require a drip edge where steel panels are in close proximity to concrete; and 5. Require verification during the permitting process that the steel meets chapter requirements. Councilmember Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: New rules for weathering-steel fences
motions.summary: The city tightened fence rules, requiring weathering steel be at least 1/8 inch thick, banning corrugated panels, and dropping an annual sealing requirement.
